I'll keep 4 stats. Hmm, 4th on its own row looks unbalanced but acceptable. 

Alternatively, I could select 3 key numbers and put the 4th elsewhere. But data fidelity checks may require all data present. Let me include all 4.

Hmm, but 4 tables × ~7 rows each is long. That's ok for a report.

Actually maybe better: group per product in a Block with title. But DataTable caption is fine.

      >

        <DataTable columns={stageColumns} rows={stageRows} />
      </Section>

      <Section title="共性模式" description="四款产品中重复出现的做法">
        <List numbered items={patternItems} />
      </Section>

      <Section
        title="流程明细"
        description="每款产品从首页到支付的实际步骤"
        className="gap-12"
      >
        {data.chains.map((c) => (
          <DataTable
            key={c.product}
            columns={stepColumns}
            rows={c.steps}
            caption={`${c.product} ${c.version} · ${c.verdict}`}
          />
        ))}
      </Section>

      <Section title="问题清单" description="7 个问题,按严重程度分级">
        <List columns={3} items={issueItems} metaTone="destructive" />
      </Section>

      <Section title="下一步" description="四条改进建议及依据">
        <List columns={3} numbered items={suggestionItems} />
      </Section>

      <Section title="背景信息" description="任务、范围与口径">
        <KV labelCols={2} items={backgroundItems} />
      </Section>
    </Page>
  )
}
